diagrams.title: Attack tree

data.name: Damage backup
data.description: Using insider threat to go bypass security, exfiltrate or deploy ransomware.

data.name: VPN tunneling
data.description: Users are on the VPN, with their personal computers, so actors will have to compromise any unpatched flaws

data.name: Malware
data.description: Their device may not have equal protection as Placebo. They can have elevated privileges in order to view HPII

data.name: Compromise WAP
data.description: Users are on the VPN, so actors will have to compromise that, then move onto zero-day attack

data.name: Zero Day attack
data.description: Compromised WAP with weak configuration or outdated patch

diagrams.description: This diagram maps the architectural data flows and trust boundaries for a Placebo Inc. workstation. It models STRIDE-based threat behaviors and potential attack vectors associated with a ransomware infection originating from either internal or external network access points, ultimately targeting corporate assets and local data stores
